title: Tetrahydrocurcumin ameliorates hepatic steatosis by restoring hepatocytes lipophagy through mTORC1-TFEB pathway in nonalcoholic steatohepatitis.
authors: Wu, Jiazhen; Guan, Fengkun; Huang, Haipiao; Chen, Hanbin; Liu, Yuhong; Zhang, Shangbin; Li, Muxia; Chen, Jianping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究四氢姜黄素通过mTORC1-TFEB通路改善脂肪肝，仅涉及蛋白-配体对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: To investigate the therapeutic effect and underlying mechanism of tetrahydrocurcumin (THC) on nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) induced by high-fat diet (HFD). METHODS: NASH rat model was established through long-term feeding HFD, and the steatosis cell model was stimulated via palmitate acid (PA). The therapeutic effect of THC was evaluated in terms of liver function, lipid metabolism, liver pathophysiology, inflammation and oxidative stress in vivo, and lipid accumulation in vitro. The alteration in lipophagy was identified by using western blot and immunofluorescence. mTORC1-TFEB signaling pathway was measured by qRT-PCR, western blot and protein-ligand docking. In addition, chloroquine and MHY1485 were further introduced to validate the effect of THC on lipophagy and mTORC1-TFEB signaling pathway, respectively. RESULTS: THC effectively improved hepatic steatosis, inflammation and oxidative stress in NASH rats, and reduced lipid accumulation in steatosis L02 cells and Hep G2 cells. THC promoted lipophagy with increasing LC3B-II as well as decreasing P62 expression via lysosomal biogenesis upregulation, which was greatly weakened after chloroquine intervention. mTORC1-TFEB is a critical pathway for regulating lysosome in autophagy, THC treatment induced TFEB nucleus translocation via inhibiting mTORC1 to upregulate lysosomal biogenesis. However, these effects were partly eliminated by mTORC1 activator MHY1485. CONCLUSION: THC restored lipophagy to reduce lipid accumulation by regulating mTORC1-TFEB pathway in NASH rats and steatosis hepatocytes. These findings suggested that THC represents a therapeutic candidate for NASH treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨四氢姜黄素（tetrahydrocurcumin, THC）对高脂饮食（high-fat diet, HFD）诱导的非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, NASH）的治疗效果及其潜在机制。方法：通过长期喂养HFD建立NASH大鼠模型，并使用棕榈酸（palmitate acid, PA）刺激脂肪变性细胞模型。在体内评估THC对肝功能、脂质代谢、肝脏病理生理、炎症和氧化应激的治疗效果，在体外评估其对脂质积累的影响。通过蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光检测脂噬（lipophagy）的变化。通过qRT-PCR、蛋白质印迹和蛋白质-配体对接检测mTORC1-TFEB信号通路。此外，分别引入氯喹和MHY1485以验证THC对脂噬和mTORC1-TFEB信号通路的作用。结果：THC有效改善了NASH大鼠的肝脏脂肪变性、炎症和氧化应激，并减少了脂肪变性L02细胞和Hep G2细胞中的脂质积累。THC通过上调溶酶体生物发生促进脂噬，表现为LC3B-II增加及P62表达降低，而氯喹干预后这一效应显著减弱。mTORC1-TFEB是自噬中调节溶酶体的关键通路，THC处理通过抑制mTORC1诱导TFEB核转位，从而上调溶酶体生物发生。然而，这些效应部分被mTORC1激活剂MHY1485消除。结论：THC通过调节NASH大鼠和脂肪变性肝细胞中的mTORC1-TFEB通路恢复脂噬以减少脂质积累。这些发现表明THC是NASH治疗的潜在候选药物。
